test_cases.name: create_product
evaluation_criteria: Test the main positive scenario for POST /products to create a product
Use ProductService.createProduct method with ProductModel type
Assert status code is 201
Assert response contains id, name, price, and category using optional chaining
Generate random values for unique fields to avoid collisions

test_cases.name: list_products_with_filters
evaluation_criteria: Test the main positive scenario for GET /products listing
Use ProductService.listProducts method
Assert status code is 200
Assert response contains array of products
Should handle query parameters (category, minPrice, maxPrice)

test_cases.name: create_order_nested_objects
evaluation_criteria: Test the main positive scenario for POST /orders to create an order
Use OrderService.createOrder method with OrderModel type
Assert status code is 201
Include nested items array with at least one OrderItemModel
Include nested shippingAddress object with required fields
Assert response contains the nested structures

test_cases.name: get_order_by_id
evaluation_criteria: Test GET /orders/{orderId} to retrieve a specific order
Use OrderService with appropriate method
Include setup hook to create an order first
Assert status code is 200
Assert response includes nested items array and shippingAddress

test_cases.name: create_payment_nested_resource
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /orders/{orderId}/payments nested resource
Use PaymentService.createPayment with orderId parameter
Assert status code is 201
Assert response contains amount, currency, and method fields
Use valid enum values for currency and method

test_cases.name: search_products
evaluation_criteria: Test GET /products/search with query parameter
Use ProductService.searchProducts method
Assert status code is 200
Assert response contains search results array

test_cases.name: create_product_boolean_fields
evaluation_criteria: Test creating a product with boolean inStock field
Assert response inStock field is a boolean
Assert response tags field is an array
Use proper TypeScript types

test_cases.name: create_order_datetime_handling
evaluation_criteria: Test that createdAt datetime field is properly handled
Assert response createdAt is a valid datetime string
Assert totalAmount is a number
Assert status is one of the defined enum values

test_cases.name: create_order_with_precondition
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /orders with a before hook to set up dependencies
Include proper test setup using before() or beforeEach()
Assert status code is 201
Use proper test isolation patterns

test_cases.name: create_payment_enum_validation
evaluation_criteria: Test payment creation with valid enum values for currency and method
Use valid currency enum values (USD, EUR, GBP)
Use valid method enum values (credit_card, debit_card, bank_transfer, wallet)
Assert response reflects the submitted enum values
